2609.01117.title: Latent Recurrent Thoughts: Recurrent Refinement of Proposed Latents for Reasoning with Frozen LLMs
2609.01117.paper_summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning unfolds in discrete token space: each step is committed as text, errors propagate, and eliciting good traces presupposes traces to imitate. Reasoning instead in a model's continuous representation space - where intermediate states are vectors rather than words - sidesteps these constraints, but leaves open how those latent states should be computed. We approach this along two axes. First, we keep a large language model (LLM) frozen and use it for what it is already good at - modeling and decoding sequences - while a small auxiliary network supplies continuous latent thoughts as input. Second, we produce those latents by recurrence: a tiny recurrent reasoner refines them over many steps, decoupling the depth of computation from the size of the model, so that the latents are a product of iterative processing rather than a single forward pass. We instantiate this as Latent Recurrent Thoughts (LRT): a task-dedicated proposer supplies base latents, a recurrent reasoner refines them through bounded residual corrections, and the frozen LLM decodes the answer. On symbolic reasoning with answer supervision but no reasoning traces (Countdown-4, Sudoku) and on natural-language reasoning (HumanEval, MBPP, StrategyQA), LRT substantially outperforms prior frozen-decoder continuous-space reasoning methods under an identical decoder, prompt, data, and training budget, and outperforms non-thinking-mode chain-of-thought prompting on the same backbone at a small fraction of its inference compute.
2609.01117.paper_summary_zh: 鏈式思考推理在離散的標記空間中展開：每一步都被記錄為文本，錯誤會傳播，而引出良好的痕跡則假設有痕跡可供模仿。相反地，在模型的連續表示空間中推理——其中中間狀態是向量而不是單詞——繞過了這些限制，但仍然開放了如何計算這些潛在狀態的問題。我們沿著兩個軸來處理這個問題。首先，我們保持一個大型語言模型（LLM）不變，並利用它已經擅長的功能——建模和解碼序列——同時一個小型輔助網絡提供連續的潛在思維作為輸入。其次，我們通過遞歸來生成這些潛在狀態：一個微小的遞歸推理器在多個步驟中對它們進行精煉，將計算的深度與模型的大小解耦，從而使潛在狀態成為迭代處理的產物，而不是單次前向傳遞的結果。我們將這實現為潛在遞歸思維（LRT）：一個專門的提議者提供基本潛在狀態，一個遞歸推理器通過有限的殘差修正來精煉它們，而凍結的LLM則解碼答案。在有答案監督但沒有推理痕跡的符號推理（Countdown-4，數獨）和自然語言推理（HumanEval，MBPP，StrategyQA）上，LRT在相同的解碼器、提示、數據和訓練預算下，顯著超越了先前的凍結解碼器連續空間推理方法，並在相同的骨幹上以其推理計算的一小部分超越了非思考模式的鏈式思考提示。
2609.01117.author: Zhaoliang Chen et.al.
